description: Environmental sensing uses radio and sensor data to detect states or changes in the surrounding environment. Examples include device-free presence and motion detection, remote sensing, and timely monitoring of distributed information sources.

featured.title: Status Update Scheduling in Remote Sensing Under Variable Activation and Propagation Delays
featured.authors: L. Badia, A. Zancanaro, G. Cisotto, und A. Munari
featured.summary: Optimizes “Status Update Scheduling in Remote Sensing Under Variable Activation and Propagation Delays”. Focus: resource decisions, constraints and performance trade-offs in Environmental Sensing, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
